body.input: Which companies expanded to the Netherlands in 2026?

response.content:
Based on available reporting, here are notable companies that expanded to the Netherlands in 2026:

## 1. Databricks
- **Announcement:** November 10, 2026
- **Details:** Databricks announced an investment of over **$500 million** in the Netherlands over the next three years. The company is expanding its largest European R&D hub in Amsterdam, plans to double its local team, and is moving into a new office in The Rock. It also aims to train more than 40,000 people in data and AI by 2030.

## 2. Oko Camera (Ukraine)
- **Announcement:** November 12, 2026
- **Details:** Ukrainian defense tech company Oko Camera opened a subsidiary in **Eindhoven**, the Netherlands. The company has been building operations in the Netherlands since **April 2026**, including sales, B2B/B2G partnerships, customer support, and R&D in microelectronics and photonics. Oko Camera also plans to set up **production of combat thermal imaging cameras** in the Netherlands, targeting a capacity of 100,000 units per year by end of 2027. As of November 2026, the company has 100 specialists across Ukraine and other European countries.

## 3. Andersen Group (USA)
- **Announcement:** Q3 2026
- **Details:** Andersen Group Inc. (NYSE: ANDG) acquired a **valuation advisory firm in the Netherlands** as part of its global expansion strategy. This was Andersen Group's first dedicated valuation business in Europe. The deal was signed in Q3 2026 and closed in Q4 2026. Overall, Andersen signed 24 acquisition transactions in 2026 representing approximately $228 million in combined annualized revenue.

## 4. Thales (France)
- **Details:** Thales signed a strategic partnership agreement with the Netherlands Ministry of Defence to **expand radar production, development, and test capacity** in Hengelo. The agreement covers construction of a near-field radar test site with an anechoic chamber, training facilities, expanded printed circuit board production, and an additional radar test tower. The expansion aims to increase antenna production in the Netherlands by 60% between 2025 and 2028.

---

The Netherlands ranked **3rd globally and 1st in Europe** for AI readiness in the 2026 IMD World Digital and AI Ranking, underscoring its attractiveness as a destination for technology-driven companies looking to expand their European activities.
